Whatever that enemy is, they're hurting us with those shockwaves!|audio = TheFinalActWave20-1.ogg|[[Engineer (Narrator)|Engineer]] on Wave 20 ([[The Narratorium]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Stereo Man''' was a tanky enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It was an enemy that had a high amount of health and [[Shield Health]] but its speed is average. It has one ability where upon losing all of its [[Shield Health]], it will drop the shield it has been carrying, removing its [[Defense]], then let out a sound soundwave with a radius of 15. This stuns towers for 2 seconds and deals 750 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''The Stereo-Man was created by Narrator so he could listen to his favorite tunes throughout the ages. He would spend hours listening as he writes his plays. If tuned to the correct frequency, it sends out a shockwave. Lefty particularly dislikes the Stereo-man as the music plays is often warped or distorted.''" ==Appearance== The '''Stereo Man''' has the appearance of an object-headed enemy with a stereo for a head, hand-crafted by The Narrator. It wears a red shirt with golden accents and a gear, black pants and shoes. On its back it has a phonograph, which can let out a shockwave. It also carries a shield made of speakers for protection, which it drops when it loses all of its [[Shield Health]]. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Mercenary Base]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Warlock]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended against this. **Stun immune towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be especially useful, as they cannot be stunned by it. **Towers like the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Commander]] can be used to boost their statistics. *As the '''Stereo Man''' has both the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] and freezing towers like the [[Freezer]] cannot be used on it. **While stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can still be used, they will only slow it down instead of fully stopping it. **While the [[DJ Booth]] cannot knock it back, its slowdown is not affected by its immunities. **Other forms of stalling like confusion or poison are not affected by its immunities, making them pretty effective. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:StereoManAttack.ogg]] |When the '''Stereo Man''' performs ''Stereo Madness'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} StereoManWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) StereoManBreak.gif|''Stereo Madness'' animation (20 December 2025 – Present) StereoManStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) StereoManDeath.gif|Death animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseStereoMan.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} StereoManIconIG.png|'''Stereo Man''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Stereo Man''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Stereo Man''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Stereo Man''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Dancer]] & [[Spotlight (Enemy)|Spotlight]]|Wave 18 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Dancer]]|hardw1 = Wave 18 (Hard)|Stereo Man|Wave 20|[[Security]]|Wave 21}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
